--- a/toolformer_filter.py
+++ b/toolformer_filter.py
@@ -13,4 +13,38 @@
 ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
 
-    raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
+    # Validation
+    arrs = [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]
+    for arr in arrs:
+        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
+            raise ValueError("Each input must be a 2D numpy array")
+        if not np.issubdtype(arr.dtype, np.floating) and not np.issubdtype(arr.dtype, np.integer):
+            raise ValueError("Input arrays must have numeric dtype")
+        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
+            raise ValueError("Input array contains non-finite values")
+        if np.any(arr > 0):
+            raise ValueError("Input array contains positive values")
+    shape = logp_with_result.shape
+    for arr in arrs[1:]:
+        if arr.shape != shape:
+            raise ValueError("All input arrays must have the same shape")
+    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
+    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
+        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")
+    n_candidates, horizon = shape
+    t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
+    raw_w = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
+    sum_w = np.sum(raw_w)
+    if sum_w > 0:
+        w = raw_w / sum_w
+    else:
+        w = raw_w
+    weighted_with_result = np.dot(logp_with_result, w)
+    weighted_call_only = np.dot(logp_call_only, w)
+    weighted_no_call = np.dot(logp_no_call, w)
+    reduction_no_call = weighted_with_result - weighted_no_call
+    reduction_call_only = weighted_with_result - weighted_call_only
+    margin = np.minimum(reduction_no_call, reduction_call_only)
+    keep = margin > tau_filter
+    return (keep, margin)
